sophie is the woman in [Video1].  she wears the blue hospital pajamas in [Image1] and [Image2], and the grippy hospital socks in [Image3], NOT the dress in [Video1]

Dr. Grayson: the doctor in [Video2], [Video3] and [Video4]. the assistant: the woman with the clipboard in [Video2], [Video3] and [Video4].

setting: mental hospital. Dr. Grayson's office — the room in [Video2] and [Video3]. this scene is a continuation of the previous scene in which sophie is on the folding chair as in [Image4], Dr. Grayson in his chair as in [Image5] (they are in the same office)

sophie and her doctor are in the middle of a discussion about when she can leave the mental hospital.   

“Tomorrow?” she says, hopefully.   
Dr. Grayson’s arms are crossed over his chest and his face displays no emotion, only his eyebrows are slightly raised.  
 “the next day?” she says, her cheeks puffing out a bit. the doctor says nothing, still. “The day after that?” she says incredulously, her lip trembling.  

“You’re going to be here a *little* longer than that I’m afraid.” he says. “And if you aren’t able to follow the treatment procedure” he nods meaningfully at a bottle of pills on his desk, “we’ll be forced to get a judge to determine whether you’re mentally stable enough to be making your own decisions."  

sophie looks horror stricken.   

sophie says nothing. loud panicky music starts to overwhelm the scene, and the scene gets blurry from her point of view. a close up on her face gets closer, as she slowly comprehends the grave predicament she is in.
